review.notes: Full review of the same head the previous review read. All 15 sampled targets checked against the cached texts (the book, arXiv:0912.0830, 1206.1654, 2111.14962, 0709.0841): 73 locators read, all support the statements. Adversarial table of 26 rows with computed values. Automatic checks all pass; dependency check 200 roadmaps, 2195 edges, 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with six sorry warnings only; one-tactic probes close none of the six theorems. Cross-roadmap citations resolved on main and at the open GeometricTopology and HeegaardFloer heads. Six small corrections (four carried over unrepaired from the previous review, two new: the collapsed link module of 3.6 and the owner named in Downstream consumers) and one format note. Not opened: Torres 1953 (paywalled) and six arXiv papers outside the sample. One arrangement question and one numbering question left to the human reviewers.
